title: TierState
description: Current permission tier and emergency stop flag. Only the owner changes it; the agent has no path to raise its own tier.

emergency_stop.description: When true every order is denied.

SchemaVersion.description: Version of this contract object. Bump only through the versioning rule in contracts/README.md.

Tier.description: T0 read-only, T1 propose-only with user signing (reserved: no v1 code path uses it), T2 bounded autonomy. Approval above a threshold is the rule TIER.APPROVAL_REQUIRED, not a tier.

UtcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, always UTC with a trailing Z.
